verdict.rationale: Turso documents programmatic management of databases, groups and tokens through its Platform API. It also markets spinning up thousands or millions of isolated databases programmatically, and its MCP integration lets an agent manage databases and run SQL. Together these let an AI-native user script operations across many items. However, the evidence never documents a dedicated bulk or batch operation (multi-database actions, batch SQL execution, bulk endpoints), so bulk work appears to require client-side looping. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API or SQL batch execution docs, multi-item operations in the CLI or MCP, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
